event.title: Experiential Labs announced its public launch
event.summary: Experiential Labs announced its public launch in a dated company video.

evidence.title: Experiential Labs Launch Video
evidence.excerpt: Experiential Labs turns the traffic and traces you already send to frontier models into a world model, a simulation of your company’s tasks, constraints, and edge cases. We use it to train a small model you fully own that earns more traffic as it improves, with the same or better quality at 40% lower cost guaranteed by an SLA. www.experientiallabs.ai/
